LABEL: MAKER_REACHABLE_OFFER
basis: V48 e073c606. maker-reachable floor = min(lowest seller-aggressed print, lowest ask-descent-dwell) post-first-lawful-stand; excludes buyer-lift trades (a resting bid is not filled by a buyer lifting the ask).

part2_the_maker_offer.note: maker offer <= all-comer (excludes buyer-lifts) but adds ask-descent; beside 711 all-comer and 396 captured

selective_taking.note: games in the all-comer offer but NOT maker-reachable (buyer-lift only); to capture them we must TAKE (cross), paying ceil(0.07*p*(1-p)*100) per contract

RULER_VIOLATION: aggressor-side (seller-only) + 10s dwell filters contradict CANON traded-at-level + trades-as-truth (any trade at/below a standing rest credits, no aggressor/dwell filter). Superseded by THE_183_ANATOMY (lawful-standability ruler).
